item.title: TTT 360: Meet And Greet
item.description:
This episode is all about follow-ups. Eric follows up on what Tan Mom has been up to in 2013; We then discuss the world’s most awkward follow-up email to a networking event; Rachelle then follows up on her Craigslist findings. Also, no emails about Rachelle’s medical emergency. You can do better than that!
